skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply legal principles and penalties for various crimes as defined in Vietnamese Criminal Law.
Analyze and interpret legal statutes and case law related to criminal offenses.
Collaborate effectively in group settings to solve legal problems.
Effectively communicate and present legal concepts and analyses.
Apply legal knowledge to resolve criminal cases and legal issues.
Initiate and manage independent study and research in criminal law.
Critically evaluate legal scenarios and make informed decisions.
